title: Transpose Table (Tables)

scenarios.title: Transpose Table applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Transpose Table (BtnTableTranspose) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableTranspose deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Transpose Table command applied to a fixture 3x2 table (interior cell selected) replaces the table with its 2x3 transpose: the cell text at (r, c) is the original (c, r) text, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Transpose Table command applied to a fixture 3x2 table (interior cell selected) replaces the table with its 2x3 transpose: the cell text at (r, c) is the original (c, r) text, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
